sources.title: Top Machine Learning Classification Algorithms - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Machine learning classification algorithms are essential tools used to categorize data into predefined classes based on learned patterns. From simple linear models to advanced neural networks, these algorithms are used in applications like spam detection, image recognition, sentiment analysis and medical diagnosis.

sources.title: Deep Learning Models for Classification: A Complete Guide - Metana
